proseStories.heading: Executive Directors Corner (ED Corner – July 2026)
proseStories.originalText: Happy July, everyone! It's been an amazing summer so far of cookouts, nights spent with friends, and of course, refreshing Happy Hours to help us cool down. ... Have a great month! Yours in Service, Alicia Lambert, Executive Director
